title.narrative: Eco-business fund for SME development in Latin America and the Caribbean – Investment Fund

description.narrative: In general, the main objectives of the eco.business Fund are (a) to protect biodiversity by providing capital for sustainable and resource efficient production, (b) to promote of companies in the sectors of sustainable agriculture, forestry, fishery and ecotourism and (c) to foster climate change mitigation and adaptation.

title.narrative: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions avoided (tonnes CO2eq) with EU support

description.narrative: SDG 13 Climate ActionFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: Target is from 2019 onwards 1 818 000 CO2eqyear reduction
Target is from 2019 onwards 1 818 000 CO2eqyear reduction

Relative net greenhouse gas emissions impact tCO2.The value of 3640000 was replaced by 3400000 during Quality Control. This is the only value that was found in the project documentation page 1011 of Promotion of Sustainable Production Practice ecobusiness Fund Latin America and the Caribbean Annual Progress Report for the Year 2021. According to the methodology note for EURF 2.21 it is not the result achieved that should be reported but the expected result i.e. the target. However the value encoded in OPSYS for the target could not be found in the documentation so this was not yet done. Please note that double counting has been identified with the value reported for the same indicator by INTV4328. This will be corrected manually in the Results Dashboard but the problem stems from the fact that INTVs 4327 and 4328 represent one single primary intervention and should be merged.
